name: advent-of-the-shenju-guo-jia-bonus-regalia-quest-counters
notes: Advent of the Shenju (c53tomoaw3, ACTION/TAMER/FATEBOUND/SPELL): "[Guo Jia Bonus] Put target Fatestone card from your banishment onto the field. If that card is a regalia, put five quest counters on your champion." Sibling fixture to advent-of-the-shenju-guo-jia-bonus-fatestone-recursion (see that fixture's meta.json for the full generated-file investigation and the hand-authored GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php cardActivatedAbilities["c53tomoaw3:0"] / customDQHandlers["c53tomoaw3:0:GuoJiaBonus-1"] implementation this exercises). This fixture covers the REGALIA branch: with a Guo Jia champion (j6dkdoxyqt) on the field and Fabled Azurite Fatestone (6ce5rzrjd9, REGALIA,ITEM type -- TAMER/FATESTONE subtype) seeded in banishment, the card is played for real from hand (FSM), its 4-reserve cost is paid for real, and the resulting MZCHOOSE is answered by picking the banished Fabled Azurite Fatestone. Verified live: Fabled Azurite Fatestone ends up on the field (myField-1) and leaves the banishment (myBanish count 0), AND the champion's Counters become '{"quest":5}' because the moved card's type contains REGALIA (checked via PropertyContains(EffectiveCardType($chosenObj), "REGALIA") -- the same pattern every other 'is a regalia' condition in this codebase uses). Break/restore verified two ways: (1) forcing $newObj = null (disabling the MZMove) makes THIS fixture fail with 'Expected card 6ce5rzrjd9 to exist in myField', and restoring passes again; (2) commenting out the AddQuestCounters($player, 5) call inside the 'if($isRegalia)' branch makes THIS fixture fail with "Expected myField-0.Counters to equal '{\"quest\":5}', got '[]'" while the sibling non-regalia fixture stays green -- confirming the regalia check and the quest-counter grant are both actually exercised here and only here.

rulesClauses: [Guo Jia Bonus] Put target Fatestone card from your banishment onto the field.
If that card is a regalia, put five quest counters on your champion.
